narr: Deep monsoon moisture remained over northern Arizona which lead to strong thunderstorms and flash flooding.
ev: Flooding was reported in farmland and along roads near the Moenkopi Wash near Tuba City. This wash flows west then south to the Little Colorado River.

Heavy rain over the Schultz Fire scar (2010) and Tunnel/Pipeline fire scar (2022) caused flash flooding. North Copeland Lane was overtopped with muddy water and debris 8 inches deep and 10 to 15 feet wide. There was also minor flooding of Henry Drive near Campbell Avenue.
Indian Route 15 from Burnside to Greasewood flooded in areas and there were puddles on the road. This is a paved road.
Major flooding was reported north of Many Farms Lake.

The river gauge on the Little Colorado River near Cameron showed a 3 foot rise between 715 PM and 1115 PM. The majority of this flow was likely from the Moenkopi Wash that had a flash flood the day before.
Lower Antelope Canyon was close due to flash flooding. Water remained in the popular tourist attraction (sandstone slot canyon) through much of August 16 due to residual flood waters (large puddles).
